subject: read.cross mapmaker format requires a genetic map

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: read.cross mapmaker format requires a genetic map
parts:
Hi,

I have a bit of feedback.  This situation seems a little bit like a chicken or an egg problem.

I am in a course on QTL, but the data is from a real research project.  For course work we are hoping through a pile of popular software that has made it challenging to keep file formats straight.  A good intersection of software seems to handle mapmaker format including R/QTL.


At the moment, I am revisiting constructing a genetic map in the first place.  In particular I am examining evidence of segregation distortion in our data, so I dutifully sent out a csv of genotype information into mapmaker format, and loading it into R/QTL resulted in this:

qtl.data = read.cross(format="mm",dir=getwd(),file = "examine_full_original_genotype.raw", estimate.map=TRUE)
Error in read.cross.mm(dir, file, mapfile, estimate.map) : 
  Missing mapfile.


First my feed back:
This seems a bit unnecessary to require the map to even get started.  I want to use R/QTL prior to the construction of the map, and I wanted to use of the segregation distortion functions in R/QTL which have no particular dependence on a map.  

One of the things I have wanted while working with onemap and R/QTL is the ability to skip the specific file format and just hand data.frame arguments with the information necessary to construct the required data.structures.  For example, I have written code to go from initial csvs to a csv format that R/QTL wants and then I load them in via read.cross, but that seems a little "round about".  Why not just expose an interface to provide the data as data.frames instead of files?


I thought about constructing a bogus map file to trip R/QTL into loading the data.   Is there an option that I am missing that will make R/QTL run without a map from mapmaker files?


Anyway, thanks for the software and listening.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] read.cross mapmaker format requires a genetic map
parts:
R/qtl was originally devised focusing on QTL mapping rather than genetic map construction.

It's a good idea, to eliminate the requirement that there be a genetic map file with the mapmaker format, and I'll add that to my "to do" list, but for now I would just create a bogus file, with all markers assigned to the same chromosomes (for example, chr "unk", for unknown).

karl
